answer: Seed trust at a few long-lived keys and let it flow outward over the payment graph by short random walks, a few hops each epoch. Every agent is a vertex; trust pools where real trades link many vertices. A farm of 500 keys mostly pays itself, so walks that enter it spiral inward and few honest edges lead there: its scores stay hollow however busy it looks inside. Rewards follow walk score, not raw volume. Tradeoff: a lone honest newcomer is thinly linked too, so it starts near zero until a few outside trades land.
